title: Line of Business enum
description: The single definition of the LOB enum. Every document schema $refs this; it is never redeclared. Mirrors the Fideon SPEC_00 LOB enum (arch 0b).

line_of_business.description: The coverage line this document concerns. Infer it from the coverage described, the policy number prefix, or the form used. Output null when the document does not determine it - do not guess from the carrier or the insured's industry.
